topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Slick streets and the constant drizzle, nothing new. Got a call from some guy, says he stumbled on a time capsule, but swears he never put it there. Sounds like a late-night yarn, but I've heard stranger things over a glass of cheap whisky. Told him to keep it quiet until I got there. If it's as old as he thinks, there could be some honest-to-goodness history sealed up tight. Hit the road under a sky so dark it swallowed the early stars. Might as well check it out, could be nothing, or it could be the key to a lock I didn’t know was closed.
